title: 第13章 就是有劲儿第14章 说话要算话
content_zh:
;;
陈大力要气死了。
因为王翠主动搂着陈楚脖子亲吻，她还伸舌头了。
旁边的马仔也是气得直跺脚。
他们做梦都想做的事情，竟然被陈大傻给实现了！
“大力哥！干他！”
陈大力当然想揍陈楚，但是刚被收拾一顿，有点没底气。
但马上想到，带了这么多的兄弟，还打不过一个？
“兄弟们，给我上！”
身后十多个人，一起冲了上去。
王翠见这么多人来打陈楚，急忙把他护在身后。
“大傻，你快点跑！我来保护你！”
“翠姐，你闪开。”
陈楚把她拉开，随后冲入对方阵营。
王翠急的都要哭了。
“别打了，我现在就报警！”
但下一秒，她忽然发现风头不对。
对面的小子被陈楚抓住，然后像扔口袋一样，一个个的扔了出去。
“哎呦……疼死我了……”
被扔出去的小子，重重的摔在地上，身上的骨头像是散了架子一样。

陈楚最后抓住陈大力。
两手没见怎么用力，把他扔出十多米远，三米多高，重重的摔在地上。
“砰……”
地上扬起一片尘土。
陈大力不动了。
“摔死人了？”
其他小子愣住了，然后一股脑的四散逃跑。
陈楚过去，摸摸陈大力的鼻息。
把他扯到一处厕所旁边的粪堆。
“陈大力，你给我记住，有再一再二，没有再三再四，下次再来挑衅，我弄死你！”
说完，朝王翠走去。
“傻楚，你没事吧？”
王翠小手在他身上检查。
“翠姐，我没事，去你家拉白菜去。”
走到了王翠家。
她才放宽心。
脸上一红。
“傻楚，你可真有劲儿，以后和我入洞房的时候可轻点啊，我这身板得让你弄散架子了。”
陈楚一阵尴尬。
“翠姐，别这样说，其实我想娶朱丽娜。”

王翠怔了怔。
忽然一笑：“傻楚，你们领证了吗？”
content_en:
;;
Chen Dali was furious.
Because Wang Cui took the initiative to hug Chen Chu's neck and kiss her, she even stuck out her tongue.
Ma Zai next to him was also so angry that he stamped his feet.
What they all dreamed of doing was actually realized by Chen Dasha!
"Brother Dali! Fuck him!"
Of course Chen Dali wanted to beat Chen Chu, but he had just been punished and felt a little unsure.
But I immediately thought, with so many brothers, I still can’t beat one?
"Brothers, come on!"
More than ten people behind him rushed forward together.
Wang Cui saw so many people coming to beat Chen Chu and hurriedly protected him behind him.
"Dasha, run quickly! I'll protect you!"
"Sister Cui, get out of the way."
Chen Chu pulled her away and then rushed into the opponent's camp.
Wang Cui was so anxious that he almost cried.
"Stop fighting, I'm calling the police now!"
But the next second, she suddenly realized that something was wrong with the limelight.
The boy opposite was caught by Chen Chu and thrown out one by one like a bag.
"Ouch...it hurts me so much..."
The boy who was thrown out fell heavily to the ground, and the bones in his body seemed to be falling apart.
Chen Chu finally caught Chen Dali.
Without using any strength with his hands, he was thrown more than ten meters away and more than three meters high, and fell heavily to the ground.
"Bang..."
A cloud of dust rose from the ground.
Chen Dali stopped moving.
"Did someone fall to death?"
The other boys were stunned, and then fled in all directions.
Chen Chu went over and touched Chen Dali's breath.
Drag him to a dung pile next to the toilet.
"Chen Dali, please remember, do it again and again, not again and again. If you provoke me next time, I will kill you!"
After saying that, he walked towards Wang Cui.
"Shachu, are you okay?"
Wang Cui checked him with her little hands.
"Sister Cui, I'm fine. I'm going to your house to pick up cabbage."
Went to Wang Cui’s house.
Then she relaxed.
His face turned red.
"Sichu, you are so energetic. Please be gentler when you enter the bridal chamber with me in the future. My body will make you lose your temper."
Chen Chu felt embarrassed for a while.
"Sister Cui, don't say that. In fact, I want to marry Zhu Lina."
Wang Cui was startled.
Suddenly smiled: "Shachu, have you received the certificate?"
